subject: BrightTree MAP — timeline impact and proposed re-baseline
messages:
From: Jen Smith <jen.smith@brighttree.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, procurement@brighttree.com
Cc: 
Date: 2027-09-13T09:02:00Z
Subject: RE: Redwood MAP - evaluation update (possible delay)

Hi Lauren,

Quick heads-up from our evaluation team: an unanticipated regulatory audit around our data retention in AP systems has paused the vendor approval track. We now expect the evaluation gate to slip by ~3 weeks unless we can scope a reduced-scope security review for the Redwood integration.

This is painful on our side — the audit team needs additional artifacts (retention matrix, audit log access details) and procurement is unlikely to greenlight the contract until the review completes. I'm attaching the internal note that kicked this off (BrightTree-eval-constraints.pdf).

Two asks from us: can Redwood propose a short-term technical fallback (lower-data intake or redaction) we can demonstrate to the audit team, and can we get a revised MAP with new dates + any flexibility on milestone-based billing/credits? Procurement is copied.

Appreciate a quick response; our internal deadline to confirm changes is EOD Friday so we can update the audit schedule.

Thanks,
Jen Smith
Head of Integrations — BrightTree
jen.smith@brighttree.com

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-09-13T10:15:00Z
Subject: Fwd: RE: Redwood MAP - evaluation update (possible delay)

Team — forwarding BrightTree's note. Key points: evaluation gate ~3-week slip, audit asks for retention/artifacts, procurement pause.

Immediate asks:
- Karthik: what does this do to the close cadence / renewal windows? Any impact to Q3 targets?
- Marcus: can we propose a technical fallback that reduces sensitive data exposure quickly (redaction/ingest knobs)? How long to stand up a canary?
- Monica: CS to own the MAP rebaseline doc and the customer comms; can you draft the new milestone table?

I want a very short triage call today (30m) to align on a proposed re-baseline and whether we should offer a milestone credit tied to the delayed evaluation. If we can't meet EOD Friday for BrightTree's internal deadline, we need to tell them ASAP.

Proposed triage: 11:00 — does that work?

— Lauren
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-09-13T12:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: RE: Redwood MAP - evaluation update (possible delay)

I can join 11:00. Quick thoughts before the call:

- Commercial impact: a 3-week slip pushes the go-live into next month and may conflict with BrightTree's fiscal cutoffs for vendor onboarding. We should (a) propose a 2–3 week re-baseline with clear gating criteria, and (b) offer a small, conditional milestone credit if onboarding milestones slip beyond the original MAP.
- Suggested credit structure: 5% of first-year committed spend if final delivery (post-eval) is >14 days late, payable as a one-time credit on first invoice. Keeps it simple and aligned to their ask.
- Deal tracking: I'll update HubSpot (BRIGHT-3241) and flag procurement as an open blocker.

Marcus — need your confirmation on whether the canary (lower-data intake) is feasible in 5 business days with a minimal runbook.

-Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-09-13T13:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: RE: Redwood MAP - evaluation update (possible delay)

We can stand up a quantized, redaction-first variant as a canary. High-level plan and risks:

- Tasks: enable ingest redaction config (1 day), deploy quantized v1 to dedicated canary pool (2 days), run smoke tests and a 4-hour throughput exercise (1 day), produce security artifact bundle for BrightTree (1 day). Total elapsed: 5 business days if we prioritize ops.
- Risks: warm KV-cache variance when moving to production; initial latency may spike under realistic traffic; limited metric coverage for audit (we'll need to produce logs and retention settings).
- Deliverable: canary-runbook.md (attached) with rollback steps and telemetry checkpoints.

If Karthik can secure an explicit ask from BrightTree that this reduced-scope demo satisfies the audit team, we can move swiftly. Otherwise this will still be helpful to show progress to procurement.

-Marcus
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Jen Smith <jen.smith@brighttree.com>
Cc: procurement@brighttree.com, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-13T15:05:00Z
Subject: BrightTree MAP — proposed re-baseline and interim canary

Jen — thanks for the quick flag and for sharing the constraints doc. We ran a fast internal triage and propose the following mutual action plan (proposal attached: Redwood-proposed-MAP-20270913.pdf). High level: 

- Interim canary: deploy redaction-first, quantized instance for audit demo — target in 5 business days (target: 2027-09-20). Marcus will own the runbook and artifacts.
- Re-baseline: shift evaluation gate to 2027-10-04 (3-week buffer). Final go-live target: 2027-10-18. Monica will update the MAP milestones and deliver a revised ownership table.
- Commercial concession: conditional 5% credit on first invoice if final delivery slips beyond the new evaluation gate by >14 days. No change to list pricing otherwise.
- Next steps: BrightTree to confirm acceptance of interim canary approach and updated MAP by 2027-09-17 EOD so procurement can be notified for their audit timeline.

Links/attachments:
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/BRIGHT-3241
- DocuSign stub for revised milestone SOW: https://www.docusign.com/ /envelope/ABCDEF1234567890
- Attachment: Redwood-proposed-MAP-20270913.pdf

If procurement needs more granularity on the artifact bundle we will provide it — Marcus, please add the retention matrix and audit log examples to the runbook. Monica, please prepare a short customer-facing note we can send along with the MAP.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute sync with procurement tomorrow if that helps move approvals.

— Lauren
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

From: Jen Smith <jen.smith@brighttree.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brighttree.com, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-14T08:30:00Z
Subject: RE: BrightTree MAP — proposed re-baseline and interim canary

Lauren — thank you, this is helpful and appreciated. Procurement is amenable to the provisional re-baseline and the interim canary as long as we get the artifact bundle for the audit team. They still need two weeks to complete internal approvals for contractual changes, so procurement will aim to sign the revised MAP by 2027-09-28.

We will plan a 30-minute procurement + security sync for 2027-09-15 to review the artifact list. Jen (procurement) will send the calendar invite.

Provisional acceptance noted — please proceed with the canary runbook and artifacts so we can present them to the auditors.

Best,
Jen Smith
Head of Integrations — BrightTree
jen.smith@brighttree.com
